name: i-cant-draw
description: You can't draw. Now you don't have to. Claude turns one sentence into a clean, hand-drawn-looking diagram.

style.title: Diagram style
style.description: crayon is coloured pencil. riso is a two-ink print. whiteboard is marker. notebook is ink on dot-grid paper. watercolour is paint and pencil. quiet is plain, for formal documents. riso, whiteboard, notebook and watercolour use fonts that come with macOS.
